query:
UPDATE article_content c
                 SET html = n.html, checksum = n.checksum, enclosures = n.enclosures::jsonb
                 FROM unnest($2::integer[], $3::text[], $4::bytea[], $5::text[])
                      AS n (seq, html, checksum, enclosures)
                 WHERE c.feed_id = $1 AND c.seq = n.seq
